dataset.name: NCI adrenocortical carcinoma cohort (2025)
dataset.description: Independent bulk RNA-seq from 33 NCI adrenocortical carcinomas linked to individual overall survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The publication combines 79 TCGA-ACC tumors and 33 tumors from an independent NCI cohort. TRACE Explorer retains only the 33 NCI patients; TCGA columns and three noncohort expression identifiers are excluded by prespecified identifier rules.

metadata.source_data_system: Pinned Zenodo expression matrix and pinned publisher supplementary clinical table
metadata.library_method: NCI CCBR RNA-seq pipeline with STAR 2.7.11b against hg38 and RSEM; publisher-provided log2(FPKM + 1) values were adjusted with limma RemoveBatchEffect
metadata.curation_note: The deposited matrix contains 115 columns: 33 NCI tumors, 79 TCGA tumors and three other identifiers. Only exact NCI identifiers with clinical rows are retained. All 33 NCI profiles map one-to-one without reading outcomes.
metadata.endpoint_note: OS is the source-reported number of months to death or last follow-up. All 33 NCI patients have a positive time and explicit vital status; nine deaths and 24 censored observations are retained.
metadata.redistribution_note: The authors release the normalized matrix on Zenodo and the clinical supplement with the open-access article; both records identify CC BY 4.0.

samples.sample_role: One primary ACC tumor RNA profile per NCI patient

expression.label: NCI ACC batch-adjusted log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Publisher-provided HUGO symbols, with an optional colon-delimited Ensembl gene identifier
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: When multiple source rows resolve to one HUGO symbol, all ambiguous rows for that symbol are excluded rather than silently aggregated.
expression.scale_note: The publication reports RSEM log2(FPKM + 1) followed by limma RemoveBatchEffect. TRACE Explorer retains these finite publisher-provided values without another transformation; negative adjusted values are valid on this scale.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Source-defined follow-up origin for the NCI ACC cohort
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause (source Vital Status = dead); source Vital Status = alive is censored at last follow-up
